tools.name: search_words
tools.description: Search the 3ammiya Egyptian Arabic slang dictionary. Accepts Arabic script (عامية), Franco-Arabic (3ammiya), or English (slang). Franco-Arabic numerals (2=ء, 3=ع, 5=خ, 7=ح) are normalized automatically.

tools.name: lookup_word
tools.description: Get the full dictionary entry for a specific Egyptian Arabic word by its URL slug. Returns all live definitions with examples, vote scores, tags, and region. Use search_words first if you don't know the exact slug.

tools.name: get_word_of_day
tools.description: Get today's featured Egyptian Arabic Word of the Day from 3ammiya. Returns a popular word with its top definition, useful for learning Egyptian slang.

tools.name: get_trending_words
tools.description: Get popular/trending Egyptian Arabic slang words from 3ammiya, ranked by community vote score. Useful for discovering widely-used slang.

tools.name: get_latest_words
tools.description: Get the most recently added Egyptian Arabic slang words on 3ammiya. Useful for seeing what new slang the community is documenting.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all topic categories (tags) available in the 3ammiya dictionary. Tags categorize words by theme (e.g., food, greetings, insults).

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List all Egyptian dialect regions in the 3ammiya dictionary. Regions indicate where a word is commonly used (e.g., Cairo, Alexandria, Upper Egypt).

tools.name: get_related_words
tools.description: Find Egyptian Arabic words related to a given word, based on shared topic tags. Useful for exploring connected slang terms and building vocabulary context.
